contexts.text: Their more hidden deceits.
For the Lord hides them...
To hide the interiors of the Word. Signified.
To hide () = to reject and bury as dead.
They hide nothing from their companions...
A hidden gift () = the truth and good which are bestowed by the Lord, unawares to man.
That it cannot be hidden from Him. Signified.
(Thus) nothing whatever is hidden... HH 469.
She hid him three months () = the fulness of time in which it did not appear.
He hid him in the sand () = that he discarded him where falsities are.
That their own falsities hid them. Signified.
For they who have acted hiddenly in the world can render themselves invisible there...
They who have secretly plotted deceits...
The things they have acted and spoken secretly are published... Thus hidden things are laid open...
Some of the means have relation to... the hiding of certain Hells beneath denser coverings...

I will give him to eat of the hidden manna () = ... wisdom stored up, such as exists with those in the Third Heaven; for (such) are in wisdom above the rest of the Angels, but in hidden wisdom, for it is inscribed on their lives, and not so much on their memories...

They hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains () = that they were in evils and falsities of evil; because (such) after death hide themselves in caves; and (such) hide themselves in the rocks of the mountains...

Fall upon us and hide us () = to be protected from the influx of Heaven; and as this is done by confirmations of evil by falsity, and of falsity from evil, these things are signified. To hide themselves from the face of Him who sits upon the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb = until they did not acknowledge anything Divine of the Lord...
The Spirits at once perceive if he wants to hide anything... so that if he wants to hide anything they at once draw forth his thoughts more into the light.
The hidden manna = the Lord as to the Divine Human...
To hide themselves = that they were destroyed, namely, goods and truths internal and external... For the things which are destroyed are hidden.
Hide us = ... lest they should suffer direful things. Explained.
